titulo: Invasion of the Influencers: ‘Widow’s Bay’ has its demons; Amity its ‘Jaws’ — Nantucket says it’s battling far worse
cuerpo: Islanders say neither sharks nor ghosts worry them — it’s the content creators on shore who are ruining their summer. As Dairy Boy founder Paige Paul plants herself in the center of the conflict, correspondent Alex Hannaford drops anchor on the simmering culture war just off Cape Cod
